Items.Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a program to support youth in entering education or obtaining employment after release from the custody of the administration for children’s services or criminal incarceration
Items.MatterName: A program to support youth in entering education or obtaining employment after release from the custody of the administration for children’s services or criminal incarceration.

Items.Title: Jointly with the Committee on Children and Youth and the Committee on Workforce Development

Resolution calling on the New York State Assembly to pass, and for the Governor to sign, A.9646A, whose companion bill S.9113A, has already been passed by the New York State Senate, to establish an insurance risk pool ensuring foster care agencies can obtain the required liability insurance to provide assistance with rapidly rising insurance costs, and, to update the State reimbursement rates to better reflect current insurance expenses, and to create the voluntary foster care agency insurance bridge fund
Items.MatterName: Establish an insurance risk pool ensuring foster care agencies can obtain the required liability insurance to provide assistance with rapidly rising insurance costs and, to update the State reimbursement rates (A.9646A/ S.9113A).
